title: Alien Breed Special Edition 92 original two-disk IPF release supplied locally

build.scope: Fresh native root compiled using eleven retained Overdrive-corrected component DLLs, frozen compiler/SDK and graphics composer. No complete moving-main ROM or standard-app admission claim.
build.sourceLineage: Overdrive 84525a2 (Chip priority -10, A501 priority 0), Alien Breed a897cc3 / db8b8a1; includes F17, Lemmings and caller-owned trap-zero compatibility, graphics installer FF8000.
build.rawManifestScope: The compiler driver inherited a baseline dictionary. Only SHA, compiled SHA, timestamp, code/graphics size, resident address and root fields were refreshed by that driver. Its historical inputs and graphicsEntries tables are not current qualification evidence; this manifest reconstructs current identities from verified frozen inputs and actual output files. Execution binaries are separately identified by each media replay.

crossRomScreenshotComparison.method: Full-viewport RGB comparison after decoding 32-bit BI_RGB BMP. Retain raw file hashes separately; the fourth stored byte is unused BGRX, not visible alpha. This decoding does not weaken complete raw-file equality for either CPU-mode pair.

limits: Opening level only; level completion, later disks/levels, save paths and two-player mode are unverified.
No physical hardware timing, throughput acceptance or audio fidelity qualification.
PAL OCS 68000, 512 KiB Chip plus 512 KiB A501, one drive only.
Native root freshly compiled from five retained sources and eleven frozen Overdrive-corrected component inputs; not a full moving-main/MorphOS build or standard-app admission.
Cross-ROM screenshot/state identity is not an acceptance gate. CPU-mode pairs require complete capture and fingerprint equality for their own ROM.
replayReceiptMode: Both images use replay.py --firmware native solely to avoid interpreting CopperStart-private bootstrap receipts after guest takeover. The actual --rom path/hash selects the executed ROM; this argument does not select another execution engine or replace the guest firmware.
